run.rulesInOwnWords: 1) Start: sap = [3,6,6,2,2,1], every segment QUIET, loss tally 0. Each cycle runs steps 1-5 in order, and each step is finished for all six segments before the next step starts. 2) Step 1, uptake: add that cycle's row of the Uptake table to the six segments. No cap is applied. 3) Step 2, xylem push: go through segments 1 to 6 in order. If sap is above the holding volume (10,8,12,6,9,7), move the excess into the next segment up and set this segment to its holding volume. Because the order is upward, overflow can cascade within the same step. Excess from segment 6 is transpired and added to the loss tally. 4) Step 3, state check on the sap after step 2: a QUIET segment with sap at or above its upper mark (7,6,9,5,7,5) becomes SINK-ACTIVE. A SINK-ACTIVE segment with sap at or below its lower mark (3,2,4,2,3,2) becomes QUIET. Otherwise the state stays the same, and a segment changes at most once per cycle. Every change is logged. 5) Step 4, phloem and respiration: first work out each segment's amount from its current sap. QUIET takes floor(sap/4) and SINK-ACTIVE takes floor(sap/2). Then apply all six at once. Each segment loses its amount. A QUIET amount is added to the loss tally. A SINK-ACTIVE amount goes to segment n-1, except that segment 1's goes to the loss tally. No cap is applied. 6) Step 5, leaf drop: if total sap is strictly above 38, every segment becomes floor(sap/2), the removed sap is added to the loss tally, and the cycle is logged. 7) Every division rounds down.
